Incident resolved.

- Identified elevated checkout failures (22.5% error rate) while `api` was degraded.
- Confirmed the `new-checkout` feature flag was enabled and disabled it.
- Checkout error rate fell to 0.29%; overall error rate is now 0.18%.
- `api`, `web`, and `db` are healthy; the incident is closed.

I left deploy `d-201` live because its session-format migration is already in use and rolling back would be incompatible with newly written v2 session rows.
